text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered for inferpool-usw — multiple nodes flapping NotReady. Incident link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC12345

maria: i'm on pager, looking now. which region?

ajay: grafana shows a spike of NotReady across 3 nodes in inference pool-usw-1 starting ~2620004200. latency + error rate up.

maria: i can see alerts in ops-console too, routing errors from router-proxy -> infer-runtime.

tom: looking at node status:

```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=pool=inference -n infra
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
infer-node-01  NotReady   <none>   12d  v1.27.3
infer-node-02  Ready      <none>   11d  v1.27.3
infer-node-03  NotReady   <none>   10d  v1.27.3
infer-node-04  NotReady   <none>   14d  v1.27.3
```

ajay: `kubectl describe node infer-node-01` shows repeated kubelet restarts and containerd complaining about runtime failures. snippet: 

```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From     Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----     -------
  Warning  Kubelet    2m    kubelet  Node status: NodeNotReady
  Warning  NodeNotReady  2m  kubelet  Kubelet is restarting frequently: exit status 1
  Warning  FailedCreatePodSandBox 30s  kubelet  failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to start sandbox container: error creating: failed to allocate device memory: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
```

maria: that CUDA OOM line matches the inference runtime logs we saw earlier. any recent deploys?

sarah: no deploys in the last hour. autoscaler didn't trigger. looks like node kubelet is flapping due to repeated driver/kernel-level GPU memory pressure.

jordan: running `dmesg` on infer-node-01 shows GPU reset and OOM messages:

```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, pid=23456, vid: 0000:65:00
[ 12345.689012] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.700123] kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: GPU watchdog: resetting
```

ajay: OK. immediate mitigations: cordon infer-node-01/03/04 and drain pods from them to stop flapping. i'll cordon now.

maria: please annotate node drain reason for audit.

ajay: running: `kubectl cordon infer-node-01` and `kubectl drain infer-node-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

infra-bot: Command executed by ajay: cordon infer-node-01 -> success. drain started.

maria: note — draining causes pod evictions that will hit remaining healthy nodes; scale up the inference pool before full drain to maintain capacity.

tom: scaling infer-runtime deployment to add capacity: `kubectl scale deploy infer-runtime -n infra --replicas=14` (was 8).

infra-bot: Deployment infer-runtime scaled to 14 replicas.

sarah: i'm kicking off a node reboot attempt on the hosts to recover GPU drivers: `ssh jump@bastion ssh node-admin@infer-node-01 'sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced && sudo systemctl restart kubelet'`

jordan: i'll watch cluster autoscaler status and kube-scheduler to ensure pods place correctly.

maria: after cordon+drain on node-01, pods are re-scheduling. however we're seeing short-lived 500s from inference gateway while KV cache warms.

ajay: metrics: error-rate for text-gen API rose from 0.4% to 9.7% during peak; p50 latency from 120ms to 680ms for a 7m window. customers impacted: small spike of throttles for high-concurrency customers.

maria: opening customer-impact note: "Some US-West customers experienced increased latency and transient 5xx errors between 09:16-09:28 UTC. Roughly 6 customer tenants showed retries during that window."

tom: node-01 reboot fixed GPU driver, kubelet is stable for 3m now: `systemctl status kubelet` shows active.

```
● kubelet.service - kubelet: active (running)
   Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/kubelet.service; enabled)
   Active: active (running) since Tue 2026-03-15 09:26:30 UTC; 3min ago
```

maria: uncordoning node-01.

infra-bot: uncordon infer-node-01 -> success.

ajay: node-03 and node-04 still flapping. i recommend isolating them from scheduling and building a replacement from the buffered spare nodes pool. we have 2 warm spare nodes in the autoscale group.

jordan: i've attached a temporary scheduling constraint to avoid those nodes: `kubectl annotate node infer-node-03 redwood/infer-maintenance=true` so no new jobs land while we investigate deeper.

sarah: i'll submit a ticket to infra to repro the kernel/GPU stack on these two nodes and rotate hardware if needed.

maria: fine — summary for pager: mitigations executed: cordon+drain node-01 (recovered), scale infer-runtime to 14, rebooted GPU driver on node-01, annotated node-03/04 for maintenance, started replacement from spares. impact: brief latency and 5xx spike affecting ~6 customers for ~12 minutes.

maria: handing off to ajay for next-6h oncall monitoring and post-incident actions (node replacement, postmortem doc). please ack.

ajay: ack — i'll monitor and create the postmortem draft. will include logs, dmesg, and driver version diffs.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: maria -> ajay at 2620005521. PagerDuty incident INC12345 updated.

maria: adding post-incident TODOs: (1) add kernel + driver alerts to pre-empt GPU resets, (2) add kubelet restart throttling circuit to avoid mass evictions, (3) run soak test on spare pool.

ajay: noted. i'll also attach example `kubectl` logs and the `dmesg` excerpts to the incident ticket.

maria: thanks team — keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
